title: Gridware named TIME’s BEST INVENTIONS 2022
summary: Gridware is excited to announce its revolutionary technology was listed as one of 200 life-changing innovations by TIME. This is a huge honor the team is proud to share with other change-making innovations from across the globe.
body_markdown:
Gridware’s unique power-grid monitoring technology was listed as one of 200 life-changing innovations by TIME.


‍


Nominations were solicited from all around the world, and then evaluated on a range of criteria, including originality, efficacy, ambition, and impact. From turning excess carbon into diamonds to the most powerful telescope yet, the list is as diverse as it is revolutionary. To quote TIME’s: “All these inventions are changing how we live, work, play, and think about what’s possible.”


‍


The entire Gridware team is honored to see their hard work listed among so many incredible ideas turned to life. Read more here:[https://time.com/collection/best-inventions-2022/6226970/gridware/](https://time.com/collection/best-inventions-2022/6226970/gridware/)
